_comment: Every condition per field type, written from the description of the rules without seeing the code, then re-derived by a second reader (07-10). Disputes were settled against the spec and the user-visible outcome; see each why.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-one
vectors.why: Vinkje: isTrue geldt voor isChecked, and '1' is the stored form of a ticked checkbox (TRUTHY).

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-true-string
vectors.why: isTrue geldt voor isChecked, which accepts the string 'true'.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-zero
vectors.why: '0' is an explicitly unticked checkbox, not isChecked, so isTrue does not hold.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-false-string
vectors.why: 'false' is in FALSY, not isChecked, so isTrue does not hold.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-empty-string
vectors.why: A never-set checkbox ('') is not isChecked; only isFalse covers empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-null
vectors.why: null is empty (never set), which is not isChecked, so isTrue does not hold.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-upper-TRUE
vectors.why: isTrue is defined as isChecked, whose TRUTHY set is exactly '1', 'true', true and 1; 'TRUE' is not in it and the spec gives no case folding for checkboxes.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-capital-True
vectors.why: 'True' is not one of the exact TRUTHY forms that isChecked accepts.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-leading-space
vectors.why: isChecked is an exact set lookup; ' 1' with a leading space is not '1'.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-trailing-space
vectors.why: isChecked is an exact set lookup; '1 ' with a trailing space is not '1'.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-true-trailing-space
vectors.why: isChecked is an exact set lookup; 'true ' is not 'true'.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-yes
vectors.why: Treating 'yes'/'on' as true is listed as a known Flow deviation; the grid uses isChecked, which does not know 'yes'.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-on
vectors.why: 'on' as true is a Flow-only deviation; isChecked does not accept it.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-two
vectors.why: A checkbox is not compared as a number; '2' is not in TRUTHY.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-one-point-zero
vectors.why: Numeric equality ('1.0' equals '1') applies to number fields only; for a checkbox '1.0' is not isChecked.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-leading-zero
vectors.why: '01' is not one of the exact TRUTHY forms.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-minus-one
vectors.why: '-1' is not in TRUTHY; a checkbox value is not judged as truthy/falsy JavaScript.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-whitespace-only
vectors.why: A space is not isChecked, whether or not it counts as empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-string-null
vectors.why: The text 'null' is not in TRUTHY.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-number-1
vectors.why: The spec names the number 1 explicitly: TRUTHY also knows the number 1, and vinkje and tint must agree.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-boolean-true
vectors.why: isChecked accepts the boolean true, a form a checkbox may arrive in.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-number-0
vectors.why: The number 0 is in FALSY, not isChecked.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-boolean-false
vectors.why: The boolean false is in FALSY, not isChecked.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-truncated-one
vectors.why: Afgekapt: operators that read the value give null; only empty/!empty still work.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-truncated-zero
vectors.why: A truncated value is unknown for a content operator, so isTrue gives null rather than false.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-folder-empty
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file, an empty value too (decision 07-10).

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-folder-null
vectors.why: A folder counts like a file, an empty value too (decision 07-10).

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-folder-checked
vectors.why: A value on a folder counts normally, because folders carry their own metadata.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-folder-unchecked
vectors.why: A folder value counts normally, and '0' is not isChecked.

vectors.name: checkbox-isTrue-preset-label
vectors.why: Preset 'checked' is isTrue/success; preset and label only name the state and do not change whether the rule matches.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-zero
vectors.why: isFalse geldt voor isUnchecked, and '0' is the stored form of an unticked checkbox.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-false-string
vectors.why: isUnchecked accepts the string 'false'.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-one
vectors.why: '1' is ticked: neither isUnchecked nor empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-true-string
vectors.why: 'true' is ticked: neither isUnchecked nor empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-empty-string
vectors.why: isFalse geldt voor isUnchecked of leeg, so a never-set checkbox ('') matches, like Flow isFalse.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-null
vectors.why: null is empty, and isFalse also holds for empty ('nooit gezet').

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-upper-FALSE
vectors.why: isUnchecked uses the exact FALSY set ('0', 'false', false, 0); 'FALSE' is neither in it nor empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-capital-False
vectors.why: 'False' is not an exact FALSY form and is not empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-leading-space
vectors.why: ' 0' is not exactly '0' and is not empty, so neither branch of isFalse holds.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-trailing-space
vectors.why: '0 ' is not exactly '0' and is not empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-no
vectors.why: 'no' is not in FALSY and is not empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-off
vectors.why: 'off' is not in FALSY and is not empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-double-zero
vectors.why: A checkbox is not parsed as a number; '00' is not an exact FALSY form.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-zero-point-zero
vectors.why: Numeric equality is for number fields only; '0.0' is not isUnchecked.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-minus-zero
vectors.why: '-0' is not an exact FALSY form and is not empty.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-two
vectors.why: '2' is neither ticked nor unticked, but it is a value, so isFalse does not hold.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-string-null
vectors.why: Only the real null is empty; the text 'null' is a value and not in FALSY.

vectors.name: checkbox-isFalse-number-0
vectors.why: isUnchecked accepts the number 0.
